Run a DR-learner for conditional LMTP means and contrasts

run_drlearner_for_subgroup_LMTP.Rd

Fits scalar LMTP TMLEs, constructs doubly robust pseudo-outcomes, and then regresses those pseudo-outcomes on user-specified conditioning variables.

Unlike run_subgroup_tmle_for_LMTP(), this function is not restricted to a finite vector of subgroup indicators. Its main use case is estimating conditional LMTP functions over continuous or multivariate conditioning covariates.

Usage

run_drlearner_for_subgroup_LMTP(
  ds,
  nuisance_factory,
  fluctuation = LMTPFluctuationSubmodel$new(),
  metalearner = make_lm_metalearner(),
  conditioning_cols = NULL,
  conditioning_fun = NULL,
  control_nuisance_factory = NULL,
  control_policy_seq = NULL,
  A_type = "continuous",
  subgroup_funs = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05
)

Arguments

ds

An LMTPData object.

nuisance_factory

An LMTPNuisanceFactory for the shifted policy.

fluctuation

An LMTPFluctuationSubmodel.

metalearner

A second-stage regression learner with signature metalearner(data, outcome_col, covariate_cols).

conditioning_cols

Optional column names in ds$df defining V.

conditioning_fun

Optional function taking ds$df and returning a data.frame of conditioning covariates.

control_nuisance_factory

Optional nuisance factory for the control or identity policy.

control_policy_seq

Optional policy used to construct the control nuisance factory when control_nuisance_factory = NULL.

A_type

Treatment type passed to identity_policy() if no control policy is supplied.

subgroup_funs

Optional subgroup functions. If supplied, subgroup means of the DR pseudo-outcomes are also returned.

alpha

Wald interval level for subgroup summaries and scalar fits.

Value

An object of class LMTPDRLearner.
